text:
olivia-sec: FYI filing this here — we're ready to start enforcing a curve whitelist at the proxy layer (x25519 + P-256 only) for TLS1.2/1.3 across eu and apac. Thinking phased canary (1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) and a fallback policy that flips to compat pool for known broken clients.

mike-sre: +1 on phased. do we have telemetry to detect curve failures vs general handshake errors? need to chart handshake_retreats and client_curve_negotiation failures. also what's the rollback plan?

olivia-sec: telemetry: cert-bot already added a kpi for "client_curve_negotiation_failures" last week, but it's sparse. plan: 1) enable detailed TLS handshake labels at edge (curve_used, client_hello_curves) 2) canary 1% for 6h, then check top 10 user agents + ASNs 3) rollback if >0.5% user-impact or 3x baseline error rate.

asha-platform: for RBAC: we'll need a scoped role for the cert rotator that can request keys/signing but not export. proposing terraform role: "roles/edge.certRotator" with conditions limiting to projects/services. I'll paste the snippet for review:
```hcl
resource "google_service_account" "rotator" {
  account_id = "edge-cert-rotator"
}
resource "google_project_iam_member" "rotator_kms" {
  role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"
  member = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.rotator.email}"
}
```

kevin-eng: KMS note: if we change policy we must ensure the rotator key's IAM binding includes the new service account before we flip enforcement. Also add an audit condition: require requestor in allowed_service_accounts list so we can track who invoked. CloudTrail/CloudAudit logs should capture signer: we should add an alert for kms:AsymmetricSign errors (403/permission denied).

cert-bot: scan summary: found 37 hosts in eu/apac still negotiating secp256r1-only clients (likely old mobile SDKs). 12 hosts are on legacy proxy config (pre-2022). full list posted to #eng-runtime. :warning:

danielle-compliance: question — do we need to record this change in the compliance change log? PCI/ISO teams usually want the rationale and test evidence. can we attach the canary report and rollback decision to the change ticket?

olivia-sec: yes — I'll open a CHG and attach: 1) threat rationale (reduce ECDHE curve downgrade risk + prefer modern curves), 2) canary plan + metrics, 3) smoke test steps, 4) rollback playbook. we'll also export CloudAudit snapshots for the canary window and store in the compliance S3 bucket with retention tag.

mike-sre: small nit — ensure nginx/h2 proxies have tls_preference set to prefer curves order; nginx example:
```
ssl_ecdh_curve X25519:secp256r1;
ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
```
Add a canary config variant and deploy via feature flag.

asha-platform: also automating RBAC change via infra PR helps: revertable plan + terraform apply with count var for canary percent. ops-runbook should include a one-click disable that flips the feature flag and restores legacy config.

kevin-eng: audit logging: add an event to the security telemetry pipeline that tags requests that hit compat pool so we can map impacted accounts. (we should not log full client_hello bytes — PII risk). store aggregated counts by account.

olivia-sec: agreed on aggregation. privacy check passed with privacy team yesterday. we will not persist raw client_hello. only curve enum + ua hash + region.

cert-bot: post-canary check (simulated): when applying curve whitelist to 1% subset using edge-canary-7, simulated handshake_fail rate = +0.07% over baseline; top UA bump came from "OldChatSDK/1.0". suggests we need a compatibility exemption for that UA for 48h and notify the partner.

danielle-compliance: good. please cc compliance on the exemption request email + include mitigation timeline. for long-term we need a documented end-of-life policy for legacy curves.

olivia-sec: will do. next steps: (a) infra PR for canary flag (asha), (b) RBAC terraform PR for rotator SA (asha), (c) KMS binding update with audit condition (kevin), (d) telemetry labels + dashboard (mike), (e) compliance CHG + artifacts (danielle). target: start 1% canary Tue 09:00 UTC.

mike-sre: I'll add dashboard panels and an alert: if compat-pool hits >0.5% of traffic or if error rate >2x baseline trigger page.

asha-platform: starting infra PR now, will ping for review when ready.

olivia-sec: thanks all. tagging followups: @mike-sre @asha-platform @kevin-eng @danielle-compliance. Backchannel in #eng-runtime for deploy details. :thumbsup:
